physico.title: Physico - Physiotherapy App
physico.desc: Physico is a mobile and web application built to make physiotherapy more accessible for patients with limited mobility. It offers a chat room that simplifies communication between patients and doctors, and patients can easily access the exercises assigned by their doctor along with videos, descriptions, sets and repetitions.
physico.subdesc: The web client uses React, Redux Toolkit and Bootstrap; the mobile app uses React Native, Expo and CSS. The backend is built with Node.js, Express.js, Socket.io and MongoDB. Physico was designed with performance and scalability in mind.

rocket.title: Rocket - Crypto Exchange Platform
rocket.desc: Rocket is a modern, secure and user-friendly exchange platform where users can buy and sell cryptocurrencies. With real-time charts, favorites, multi-language support and Firebase-based account management, it's a practical way to manage your digital assets.
rocket.subdesc: Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Firebase and i18n, Rocket is optimized for both beginners and experienced investors. Explore the crypto market, invest and track your portfolio in real time!
